query: 对比 2026-03 上半月和下半月的日均转化率和退款率走势,有什么变化?

ground_truth.factual_anchor: 见 factual_anchor_snapshots_round3.tsv,03 月上下半月双指标对比 | SQL: WITH daily AS (SELECT t.date, SUM(t.visitors) AS uv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order o WHERE o.date=t.date) AS orders, (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN o.is_refund THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM fact_order o WHERE o.date=t.date) AS refund_rate FROM fact_traffic t WHERE t.date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY t.date) SELECT CASE WHEN date <= DATE '2026-03-15' THEN 'H1_03' ELSE 'H2_03' END AS half, ROUND(AVG(100.0*orders/NULLIF(uv,0)), 2) AS daily_conv_pct, ROUND(100.0*AVG(refund_rate), 2) AS daily_refund_pct, COUNT(*) AS days FROM daily GROUP BY half ORDER BY half;

rubric_notes: round3 cross_period;上下半月 + 双指标(转化率 + 退款率)对比,与 v1.0 q_019 上下半月不同(q_019 是 04 月含 case 1,q_067 是 03 月正常区间);预期 baseline FAIL;6.4 演示池候选。

query: 2026-02 月(从 02-17 开始,共 12 天)和 2026-04 月(30 天)的 GMV 对比,跨度 2 个月的变化趋势是什么?

ground_truth.factual_anchor: 见 factual_anchor_snapshots_round3.tsv,02 月(部分)vs 04 月 GMV 同比对比;注:02 月数据只有 02-17~28 共 12 天 | SQL: SELECT SUBSTR(date::VARCHAR, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(gmv), 2) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS days FROM fact_order WHERE (date BETWEEN '2026-02-17' AND '2026-02-28') OR (date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

rubric_notes: round3 cross_period;跨度更大的月度对比(同比类,02 月不完整 12 天 vs 04 月 30 天);预期 baseline FAIL,且理想答案应识别 02 月只有 12 天,需要日均化对比;6.4 演示池候选。

query: 把 2026-03、2026-04、2026-05 三个月份的 GMV、UV、转化率三个指标分别列出,各月趋势如何?

ground_truth.factual_anchor: 见 factual_anchor_snapshots_round3.tsv,3 月份 × 3 指标矩阵;注:05 月只有 17 天 | SQL: WITH monthly AS (SELECT SUBSTR(o.date::VARCHAR, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(o.gmv), 2) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT o.date) AS days FROM fact_order o WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-05-17' GROUP BY month), monthly_uv AS (SELECT SUBSTR(t.date::VARCHAR, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(t.visitors) AS uv FROM fact_traffic t WHERE t.date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-05-17' GROUP BY month) SELECT m.month, m.orders, m.gmv, mu.uv, ROUND(100.0*m.orders/NULLIF(mu.uv,0), 2) AS conv_pct, m.days FROM monthly m JOIN monthly_uv mu USING(month) ORDER BY m.month;

rubric_notes: round3 cross_period;3 月份 × 3 指标多段分组(complex),与 v1.0 q_020 90 天 3 段子品类不同(q_020 是子品类维度,q_069 是月度 × 指标矩阵);预期 baseline FAIL;6.4 演示池候选。
